race.comment: ROCK FEST (1) resumed from a 329-day break with a bang, winning from the back by 1.1L in an outstanding performance. He's on the path to the Railway and he ran right up to his best first-up. Out to 1400m is a big tick, he's drawn well and with a new peak figure incoming, he can repeat the dose. FAST HARRY (7) closed nicely from the back behind ROCK FEST, but was still beaten 3L there. It was a good performance fresh and he's won 2/3 when second-up in the past. Drawn better now and can make his presence felt again. TERRITORY MAN (11) comes here fresh and on the back of a strong trial recently. Disappointed at the end of last prep but can return with a bang. WESTERN LADY (6) has won 2/3 first-up and her recent trial suggests she can fire again on resumption.
